messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Re: No progress bar when using .parallel=TRUE?
parts:
Yes, as I described above, when using .progress="text" and .parallel=TRUE together I get no progress bar. For example:

require(plyr); require(doMC)
set.seed(seed=123)
list_ <- llply(rnorm(10^4), function(x) x^2, .progress="text") # gives progress bar
registerDoMC(cores=4)
list_ <- llply(rnorm(10^4), function(x) x^2, .progress="text", .parallel=TRUE) # does not give progress bar
On Sunday, July 8, 2012 3:24:13 PM UTC-7, James McCreight wrote:
are you also using .progress='text' or some such?

I get no progress bar (using .progress="text") when .parallel=TRUE.  It seems this issue was discussed at the github repo (https://github.com/hadley/plyr/pull/77), but was this resolved?  Perhaps in a development version?

Thanks,
Scott Chamberlain
